name: Aave V4 Agentic Protocol Ontology
inspired_by: Databricks Genie Ontology (Domains, Canonical Terms, Exception Rules, Source-Linked Snippets, and Curation Governance)

domains.name: Liquidity Core (Hub)
domains.summary: Immutable single-pool accounting ledger holding underlying ERC-20 liquidity, enforcing Spoke add/draw caps, risk premium thresholds, deficits, and interest accrual.

domains.name: Risk Markets (Spokes)
domains.summary: Upgradeable user-facing modules managing collateral valuation, per-spoke AaveOracle pricing, reserve limits, and specialized markets (Babylon BTC vault, ERC-4626 Tokenization).

domains.name: Risk Premium & Accrual
domains.summary: Dual-stream debt separating principal drawn debt from collateral-risk premium debt via virtual premium shares and signed RAY offsets.

domains.name: Dynamic Risk Configuration
domains.summary: Append-only uint32 dynamicConfigKey snapshots isolating existing borrower positions from sudden Collateral Factor or Liquidation Bonus parameter tightening.

domains.name: Liquidation & Deficit Engine
domains.summary: Target Health Factor liquidation sizing, 1,000 USD dust prevention, Dutch-auction linear bonus, share payouts, and cross-Spoke deficit elimination.

domains.name: Gateways, Access & Config Engine
domains.summary: EIP-712 intent gateways, wrapped ETH adapters, role-based AccessManager authority, and delegatecall governance payload engine.

terms.rule: Accrued premium debt is computed as ((premiumShares * drawnIndex).toInt256() - premiumOffsetRay).toUint256(). Because premiumOffsetRay is signed int256, it can legitimately become negative when a user's previously accrued premium exceeds the recalibrated (newPremiumShares * drawnIndex) baseline during refreshPremium.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Assuming offsets are unsigned (uint256) and clamping or asserting offset >= 0 in formal specs or Z3 models.

terms.rule: supply(), repay(), and liquidationCall() intentionally do NOT refresh User Risk Premium (RP_u) or rebind dynamicConfigKey snapshots (liquidationCall only touches premium in its flow when relevant, never updating dynamicConfigKey). Only risk-increasing operations (borrow, withdraw, setUsingAsCollateral) rebind dynamicConfigKey to latest and revert if unhealthy.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Assuming Governor calls to addDynamicReserveConfig immediately rebind or liquidate passive open borrowers, or expecting supply()/repay() to trigger a premium recalibration.

terms.rule: All four conversion helpers in SharesMath.sol add VIRTUAL_ASSETS = 1e6 and VIRTUAL_SHARES = 1e6 unconditionally, bounding share-inflation rounding attacks on empty or near-empty reserves.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Writing Hub solvency or share conversion proofs using raw totalAssets / totalShares ratios without the +1e6 virtual offset.

terms.rule: Hub.sol inherits AccessManagedUpgradeable (used with HubInstance.initialize and HUB_REVISION), yet protocol architecture deploys Hub as immutable (non-upgradeable core) while keeping Spokes upgradeable.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Seeing AccessManagedUpgradeable in Hub.sol line 21 and wrongly treating Hub as a governance-upgradeable proxy in threat models.

terms.term: Dust Threshold Override over Target Health Factor
terms.rule: Normally liquidation debt is capped to restore TargetHealthFactor. However, if post-liquidation remaining debt would fall below DUST_LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD (1,000 USD value units) and the liquidator signals full-debt coverage intent, the protocol expands max liquidatable debt to wipe the entire debt.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Asserting post-liquidation HF <= TargetHealthFactor universally in symbolic specs without exempting dust-clearing liquidations.

terms.rule: On BabylonSpoke, canonical liquidationCall reverts unconditionally. Liquidations occur exclusively through LIQUIDATION_MANAGER with bounded collateral caps, zero liquidation fee, underlying-asset payout only, and premium debt repaid first.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Applying generic Spoke liquidation liveness invariants ('anyone can liquidate when HF < 1') directly to BabylonSpoke.

terms.rule: Idle liquidity swept to external strategies via Hub.sweep() remains counted inside the AssetInterestRateStrategy utilization denominator so base drawn borrow rates stay completely unaffected by reinvestment allocations.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Computing Hub utilization solely from contract ERC-20 balanceOf(hub) and mispredicting rate spikes on reinvestment sweeps.

terms.term: Python Z3 Proof vs. Solidity Bytecode Boundary
terms.rule: tests/misc/z3/*.py proves algebraic inequalities over Python ints (fromRayDown/Up in commons.py). These do not prove compiled Solidity execution—only Halmos/Certora rules bound to compiled EVM bytecode verify actual storage, casting, and branching parity.
terms.naive_agent_trap: Treating passing Python Z3 tests in tests/misc/z3/ as full formal verification of LiquidationLogic.sol.

snippets.title: Audit Hub Accounting & Spoke Contagion Isolation
snippets.context_markdown:
## Slice: Hub Accounting & Contagion Boundary
- **Invariants**: (1) totalBorrowedShares == sum(spokeDebtShares); (2) hubAddedAssets >= sum(spokeAddedAssets); (3) hubAddedShares == sum(spokeAddedShares); (4) supplySharePrice & drawnIndex monotonically non-decreasing.
- **Rounding Seam (`SharesMath.sol#L13-62`)**: All 4 helpers use `VIRTUAL_ASSETS = 1e6`, `VIRTUAL_SHARES = 1e6`. `add`/`restore` favor Hub upward/downward conservatively.
- **Cross-Spoke Isolation (`Hub.sol#L158-360`)**: Each Spoke is constrained by `addCap`, `drawCap`, `riskPremiumThreshold`, and `active/halted` state. `reportDeficit`/`eliminateDeficit` transfer shares without external capital injection.
- **Trap to Avoid**: Reinvestment sweeps (`Hub.sweep#L406`) stay in utilization denominator (`AssetInterestRateStrategy`); Hub is deployed immutable despite inheriting `AccessManagedUpgradeable`.

snippets.title: Verify Risk Premium Accrual & refreshPremium Conservation
snippets.context_markdown:
## Slice: Dual-Stream Interest & Risk Premium
- **Greedy Coverage (`docs/overview.md#risk-premium`)**: Sort enabled collaterals ascending by `CR_i` (`0..1000_00` BPS); weight only the safest slice needed to cover `totalDebt`.
- **Formula (`Premium.sol#L17-22`)**: `((premiumShares * drawnIndex).toInt256() - premiumOffsetRay).toUint256()`. Note `premiumOffsetRay` is **signed `int256`**.
- **Conservation Obligation**: Calling `Hub.refreshPremium#L362` must preserve exact total accrued premium debt before vs. after recalculating shares & offset.
- **Trap to Avoid**: `supply` & `repay` intentionally do NOT refresh `RP_u`; use `updateUserRiskPremium` (`Spoke.sol#L418`) for explicit recalibration.

snippets.title: Verify Target-HF Liquidation, Dust & Babylon Override
snippets.context_markdown:
## Slice: Liquidation Sizing, Dust & Specialized Spokes
- **Target HF vs Close Factor**: Repay enough debt to restore `TargetHealthFactor >= HEALTH_FACTOR_LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD` (`LiquidationLogic.sol#L194`).
- **Dust Rule**: `DUST_LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 1_000 USD` expands max debt to allow full clearance when residual debt < dust and full coverage is intended.
- **Dutch-Auction Bonus (`LiquidationLogic.sol#L312`)**: Interpolates linearly from `(maxLB - 100%) * lbFactor + 100%` at threshold up to `maxLB` at `healthFactorForMaxBonus`.
- **BabylonSpoke Exception (`BabylonSpoke.sol#L45`)**: Canonical `liquidationCall` reverts; only `LIQUIDATION_MANAGER` can liquidate, capped collateral, zero fee, asset payout only.
- **Proof Obligation Gap**: Port `tests/misc/z3/debt_to_liquidate.py` to Halmos/CVL so checks bind to compiled `.sol` bytecode.

snippets.title: Audit Dynamic Risk Configuration & Rebinding Safety
snippets.context_markdown:
## Slice: Per-Position uint32 dynamicConfigKey Snapshots
- **Mechanism**: Governor updates append a new key via `addDynamicReserveConfig` (`Spoke.sol#L194`) without mutating open positions.
- **Rebind Rule**: `borrow`, `withdraw`, and `setUsingAsCollateral` rebind the user's snapshot to latest and revert if unhealthy; `supply`, `repay`, `liquidationCall`, and `updateUserRiskPremium` keep the prior key.
- **Override**: `updateUserDynamicConfig` (`Spoke.sol#L427`) refreshes all collateral snapshots for a user and recalculates `RP_u`.
